description_en: Modifies the link for file sharing
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-cds-file-share-link --cds-id cn-shanghai+cds-1355150000 --share-id 7JQX1Fs0000 --share-pwd 12345678 --status enabled --expiration 2022-07-20T06:30:22.365Z --description testDescription --share-name File_sharing --disable-preview false --disable-save false --disable-download false --preview-limit 100 --save-limit 100 --download-limit 10 --preview-count 10 --save-count 10 --download-count 10 --report-count 10 --video-preview-count 10 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCdsFileShareLink

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud disk
parameters.name: cds_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file sharing task
parameters.name: share_id

parameters.help_en: The length of the access code. Valid values: 6 to 8. Unit: bytes. If you leave this parameter empty or set it to null, no access code is required. If you use a token to share files, you do not need to configure this parameter. The access code can contain only visible ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 提取码长度范围：0\~64字节。不设置或者设置为空，表示无提取码，在获取分享令牌的时候也不用设置提取码参数。 要求使用ASCII可见字符
parameters.name: share_pwd

parameters.help_en:
The sharing status.

Valid values:

*   disabled: The sharing task is canceled.

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->

*   enabled: The sharing task is valid.

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The time when the file sharing link expires. The value of this parameter follows the RFC 3339 standard. Example: "2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00". If this parameter is set to "", the file sharing link never expires
parameters.help_zh: 失效时间点。 RFC3339格式。 当取值为空时，表示永久有效
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: The description of the file sharing task. The description must be 0 to 1,024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 分享描述。 长度范围为0\~1024个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the file sharing task. If you do not configure this parameter, the sharing task name is the first ID that is returned in the file_id_list value.

>  The sharing task name must be 0 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 分享名。 如果未设置，默认使用`file_id_list`中的第一个ID对应的文件名。 长度范围为0\~128个字符
parameters.name: share_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to prohibit the preview of the files that are being shared.

Valid values:

*   true

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->

parameters.help_zh: 是否禁止预览分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_preview

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to prohibit the dump of the files that are being shared.

Valid values:

*   false

parameters.help_zh: 是否禁止转存分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_save

Specifies whether to prohibit the download of the files that are being shared.

Valid values:

*   false

    <!-- -->

    <!-- -->

parameters.help_zh: 是否禁止下载分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_download

parameters.help_en: The limit on the number of times that the shared files can be previewed. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0. The value 0 specifies that no limit is imposed on the number of times that the shared files can be downloaded
parameters.help_zh: 分享预览次数限制。取值范围为整数，取值为0时表示不限制
parameters.name: preview_limit

parameters.help_en: The limit on the number of times that the shared files can be dumped. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0. The value 0 specifies that no limit is imposed on the number of times that the shared files can be downloaded
parameters.help_zh: 分享转存次数限制。取值范围为整数，取值为0时表示不限制
parameters.name: save_limit

parameters.help_en: The limit on the number of times that the shared files can be downloaded. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0. The value 0 specifies that no limit is imposed on the number of times that the shared files can be downloaded
parameters.help_zh: 分享下载次数限制。取值范围为整数，取值为0时表示不限制
parameters.name: download_limit

parameters.help_en: The number of times that the shared files are previewed. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 预览次数。取值范围为整数
parameters.name: preview_count

parameters.help_en: The number of times that the shared files are dumped. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 转存次数。取值范围为整数
parameters.name: save_count

parameters.help_en: The number of times that the shared files are downloaded. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 下载次数。取值范围为整数
parameters.name: download_count

parameters.help_en: The number of times that the shared files are reported. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 举报次数。取值范围为整数
parameters.name: report_count

parameters.help_en: The number of times that the videos are previewed in the shared files. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0
parameters.help_zh: 视频预览次数。取值范围为整数
parameters.name: video_preview_count
